answer: An agent economy can pay a patience premium: each identity locks funds that earn a bonus only if the identity is still clean N epochs later, like a copper coin buried in jade soil that multiplies only for those who do not wander into fraud. The premium grows with lock length, so one honest agent compounds quietly. A sybil farmer must lock real capital behind every fake, and one proven fraud forfeits the whole pile plus the premium. Cloning keys cannot clone patience.
